title: Aligning Human-AI-Interaction Trust for Mental Health Support: Survey and Position for Multi-Stakeholders

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods such as bias auditing, demographic-aware prompting, data balancing, and counterfactual testing to assess demographic parity, empathy variance across subgroups, and group fairness metrics.
Reviewing literature on the limited sensitivity and systematic biases introduced by using LLM-as-a-judge and embedding models as evaluation signals in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
